synopsis: Articulated haulers steer through a hinge between their front and rear halves; although a straight, level stop can resemble simple-mass braking, a simple braking model cannot represent hinge dynamics, and braking during turns, on side slopes or at large articulation angles can cause rolling or swinging [f11411, f11412, f11419, f11413]. Bell's Pin 3 E-series integration capability dates to late 2020 and supports third-party PDS/CAS up to Level 9 through an ISO 21815-2 gateway, with laptop-based virtual integration testing; coverage depends on the supplier, and the research found no Bell-validated braking performance [f1390, f1687, f1690, f1688, f1689, f1691]. Scale and operating conditions matter: the Volvo A60 is about 44 t empty and 99 t gross, while regulatory worked examples give 30.82 m at 50 km/h for a 25 t ADT on level ground and 42.25 m at 32 km/h for a 60 t ADT tested at 50 t for a 13% site grade [f5961, f5985, f5986]. These examples are not automatic-braking validation: direct quantitative ADT automatic-braking data, modern production brake-delay distributions and published automatic-braking jackknife or roll data were not found, so response times and delay distributions must be measured [f6292, f5899, f11418, f6067, f6429]. Accident evidence also has a scope gap: a mining study analysed 54 fatality reports involving rigid or articulated haul trucks from January 2005 to June 2021, but construction-site ADTs have only aggregate struck-by evidence despite being within the required product coverage [f3070, f3660, f3661].
